item.title: "Salz in die Wunden": Chinas Netzgemeinde rechnet mit Professorin ab
item.description: Ob als Essenslieferant, Fahrer oder Paketzulieferer: Millionen Chinesen halten sich mit kleinen, meist schlecht bezahlten Aufträgen über Wasser. Mit der Bezeichnung dieser weit verbreiteten sogenannten Gig-Arbeit als eine Form von "Wohlfahrt" hat eine prominente Wirtschaftsprofessorin in China nun einen Sturm der Entrüstung ausgelöst.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ob als Essenslieferant, Fahrer oder Paketzulieferer: Millionen Chinesen halten sich mit kleinen, meist schlecht bezahlten Aufträgen über Wasser. Mit der Bezeichnung dieser weit verbreiteten sogenannten Gig-Arbeit als eine Form von "Wohlfahrt" hat eine prominente Wirtschaftsprofessorin in China nun einen Sturm der Entrüstung ausgelöst. Aus arbeitsökonomischer Sicht sei "Flexibilität an sich eine Form von Wohlfahrt", argumentierte Zhang Dandan, Professorin und Vizedekanin an der renommierten Peking-Universität, in einer populären Finanzsendung. Während Festangestellte ihre zeitliche Flexibilität gegen Rentenansprüche und andere Sozialleistungen eintauschten, genössen flexible Arbeitskräfte eine größere Kontrolle über ihre Zeit – allerdings auf Kosten einer schwächeren sozialen Absicherung. Die Kommentare zogen eine Welle der Empörung im Internet nach sich. Nutzer sozialer Medien warfen Zhang vor, die harte Realität der Gig-Ökonomie zu ignorieren. Zhang selbst reagierte nicht auf eine Anfrage der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters nach einer Stellungnahme. Die Äußerungen treffen in China einen wunden Punkt, da eine sich abkühlende Konjunktur feste Vollzeitstellen immer seltener werden lässt. Dem Forschungsinstitut China New Employment Forms zufolge wird die Zahl der flexibel Beschäftigten in diesem Jahr auf 320 Millionen steigen - das wären etwa 44 Prozent der städtischen Arbeitskräfte des Landes. Diese Zahl entspricht in etwa der gesamten Bevölkerung der USA. Branchenexperten warnen zudem, dass die Verbreitung von Jobs, bei denen Arbeitgeber keine Sozialversicherungsbeiträge leisten müssen, die ohnehin angespannten Sozial- und Rentensysteme Chinas langfristig zusätzlich gefährdet. Der einflussreiche Kommentator Hu Xijin, früherer Chefredakteur der staatlich unterstützten Zeitung "Global Times", nannte Zhangs Äußerungen "schockierend" und "inakzeptabel". Gleichwohl wiesen einige Nutzer darauf hin, dass sich Zhangs akademische Karriere bisher schwerpunktmäßig mit den Problemen von Gig-Arbeitern und der Forderung nach deren sozialer Absicherung befasst habe. Dennoch wurde ihre Bewertung von "Flexibilität" als Vorteil weithin als unsensibel empfunden. "Solche Kommentare von Experten sind nichts anderes als Salz in die Wunden derjenigen ohne Arbeitsplatzsicherheit zu streuen", schrieb ein Nutzer auf der Plattform Weibo. Ein anderer verwies auf den unerbittlichen Druck auf Essenslieferanten und Kuriere: "Jeden Tag kämpfen sie verbissen gegen den Algorithmus der Plattform, ohne Pause. Flexible Arbeit ist in Wahrheit keine freie Entscheidung, sondern eine unausweichliche Notwendigkeit."

item.title: Pirates attack 13 vessels in 2026 so far: Here's why Somali piracy is making a comeback
item.description: Somali piracy is resurging after years of relative calm, with at least 13 commercial vessels attacked or targeted in 2026. Six ships have been seized since April, while experts cite unresolved conditions in Somalia and the US-Iran war as possible factors behind the renewed threat.
item.dc:creator: Swati Gandhi
item.content:encoded: After years of relative calm, Somali piracy is once again resurging, with a growing number of vessels being targeted off Somalia and in the Gulf of Aden, prompting renewed concerns among the international shipping community.According to Reuters, at least 13 commercial ships had been attacked or targeted as of 21 August, marking a sharp reversal after piracy in the region declined significantly in recent years.Tankers reel under Somali piracy threatThe latest victim of Somali pirates was an oil tanker under US sanctions for allegedly transporting Iranian petroleum products that was boarded off the coast of Yemen and diverted towards Somalia. According to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), Sibu 1, the Eritrea-flagged vessel, was seized on 20 August by six armed men. The tanker was placed under US Treasury sanctions in December last year over allegations that it was part of a shadow fleet used to help Iranian petroleum products circumvent Washington’s sanctions.13 vessels attacked by Somali piratesSince April, at least six tankers and cargo ships have been seized. According to a report in The Chosun Daily, the hijacking of the Palau-flagged tanker Honor 25 in Somali waters in April marked the beginning of these incidents. On 26 April, pirates seized the Saint Kitts and Nevis-flagged cargo ship Sword, followed by the Togo-flagged tanker Eureka on 2 May and the Tanzania-flagged tanker Asana on 17 July. On the same day, they also hijacked the Cameroon-flagged cargo vessel Lutuf, which was carrying Turkish military weapons. Six merchant vessels were captured over four months.Citing reports from the UKMTO and data from the International Maritime Bureau (IMB), Reuters reported that Sibu 1 became the 13th victim of the pirates off the coast of Somalia or in the Gulf of Aden, which links Somalia and Yemen.History of Somali piracyAccording to The Chosun Daily, pirates emerged in the early 1990s after the civil war in Somalia collapsed the national economy. Pirates used to hijack ships in the Gulf of Aden and along Somalia's coast to steal cargo and extort ransoms. According to a 2011 UN report, estimated annual losses were reported at $7 billion, with insurers forced to pay exorbitant premiums to cover these losses.These attacks were brought to an end by a coordinated international security effort involving a 47-nation coalition naval force led by NATO countries, including the United States. The US military expanded operations, deploying aircraft carrier strike groups. A resurgence of hijackings between 2023 and 2024 also subsided after a strong naval response.According to IMB data, just five such attacks were recorded in 2025, a sharp decline from the hundreds of attacks carried out by Somali pirates between 2008 and 2014, which triggered a security crisis in the western Indian Ocean and cost the global economy billions of dollars, including hundreds of millions of dollars in ransom payments.Experts on Somali piracy issueHowever, experts warn that the underlying economic and security problems in Somalia remain unresolved, meaning piracy could resurface at any time. Timothy Walker, a senior researcher at the Institute for Security Studies in Pretoria, told Reuters, "The piracy was always suppressed. It was never really fully eradicated."Experts have also pointed to the impact of the US-Iran war on the resurgence in piracy, including higher oil prices making tankers more attractive targets and the diversion of naval assets from anti-piracy operations to the Strait of Hormuz and Red Sea to counter threats from Iran and its Houthi allies in Yemen.Additionally, some experts have cited evidence of collaboration between the Iran-backed rebel group, the Houthis, and Somali pirates, after several vessels were seized near the Yemeni coast.(with Reuters inputs)

item.title: El IBEX 35 abre plano pendiente de Nvidia, la geopolítica y Jackson Hole
item.description: El índice español IBEX 35 abría la sesión del lunes sin grandes variaciones, cerca de los 20.000 puntos, mientras los mercados aguardaban por los resultados de Nvidia el miércoles, en un contexto de altas expectativas en torno a la inteligencia artificial, y los anuncios de sanciones de Estados Unidos a Irán y sus socios comerciales, que se conocerán más tarde en la jornada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El índice español IBEX 35 (.IBEX) abría la sesión del lunes sin grandes variaciones, cerca de los 20.000 puntos, mientras los mercados aguardaban por los resultados de Nvidia (NVDA.O) el miércoles, en un contexto de altas expectativas en torno a la inteligencia artificial, y los anuncios de sanciones de Estados Unidos a Irán y sus socios comerciales, que se conocerán más tarde en la jornada. Los datos del índice de precios del gasto en consumo personal (PCE, por sus siglas en inglés) de julio y el discurso del presidente de la Fed, Kevin Warsh, en el simposio de Jackson Hole de esta semana también serán objeto de atención en busca de nuevas pistas sobre las perspectivas de las tasas de interés en EEUU. "Toca esperar y ver. Sin susto, pero con cierta cautela. Es probable que las bolsas convencionales retrocedan c.-0,5%, mientras que la tecnología c.-1%. Después, estabilización hasta el miércoles noche/jueves por la mañana, según salga Nvidia", dijeron los analistas de Bankinter en su canal de Telegram. A las 0710 GMT del lunes, el selectivo bursátil español IBEX 35 subía 30,40 puntos, un 0,15%, hasta 19.991,90 puntos, mientras que el índice de grandes valores europeos FTSE Eurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) retrocedía un 0,12%. En el sector bancario, Santander (SAN.MC) subía un 0,18%, BBVA (BBVA.MC) se anotaba un 0,20%, Caixabank (CABK.MC) avanzaba un 0,27%, Sabadell (SABE.MC) ganaba un 0,60%, Bankinter (BKT.MC) se revalorizaba un 0,21% y Unicaja Banco (UNI.MC) subía un 0,17%. Entre los grandes valores no financieros, Telefónica (TEF.MC) se anotaba un 0,58%, Inditex (ITX.MC) avanzaba un 0,07%, Iberdrola (IBE.MC) se dejaba un 0,05%, Cellnex (CLNX.MC) ganaba un 0,96% y la petrolera Repsol (REP.MC) perdía un 0,57%.

item.title: Westfield brand owner Scentre to sell half of Queensland shopping centre for $632 mln
item.description: Scentre Group said on Monday Australian Retirement Trust will acquire a 50% stake in its Queensland shopping centre Westfield Mt Gravatt for A$882.5 million ($632.22 million), a 3.5% premium to the property's December 2025 book value.
item.dc:creator: Kumar Tanishk
item.content:encoded: Scentre Group (SCG.AX) said on Monday Australian Retirement Trust will acquire a 50% stake in its Queensland shopping centre Westfield Mt Gravatt for A$882.5 million ($632.22 million), a 3.5% premium to the property's December 2025 book value. Here are some other details: Over the past 13 months, Westfield brand owner Scentre has attracted A$3.1 billion in third-party capital by forming joint ventures around its assets under a long-term plan. The Queensland shopping centre attracted more than 17 million customer visits in the prior year and generated business partner sales exceeding A$1 billion, Scentre said. The group will retain management responsibilities. The deal includes the sale of a 50% direct property stake for A$870 million based on a 5.50% property yield and a 50% stake in adjacent land for A$12.5 million. Selling assets at sub-cost-of-capital yields is value-accretive, while retaining a 50% stake and full-property fee streams preserves meaningful exposure and unlocks capital for higher-value redeployment, said Emanuel Ajay Datt, MD of Datt Group. "We expect this transaction will firm up Scentre's ability to distribute income to shareholders," Datt said. The trust had [USN:L4N3XT06Y TEXT:"acquired"] a nearly 20% interest in Scentre’s flagship Westfield Sydney mall for A$864 million last year. Peer Vicinity (VCX.AX) , which owns centres including Queen Victoria Building in Sydney, has also been active in acquisitions. In May 2026, it [USN:TUEBWYJ0S TEXT:"purchased "]Eastern Creek Quarter in western Sydney from Frasers Property (FRPL.SI) for A$400 million. Scentre shares have traded in a range of A$3.28 to A$4.24 over the past year and have fallen more than 13% from their January peak. Its shares closed flat on the day. ($1 = 1.3959 Australian dollars)

item.title: US national debt crosses $40 trn: What govt debt means and how it works
item.description: US national debt has crossed $40 trillion. Here's a guide to how government debt works, why governments borrow, who they owe money to, how they repay it and what debt ceilings mean ...
item.dc:creator: Rimjhim Singh
item.content:encoded: The United States' national debt has crossed the $40-trillion mark for the first time, according to US Treasury data.  A government's debt can sound like a simple number, but it is the result of years of borrowing. Governments borrow to meet expenses when their revenues are not enough to cover their spending. They then have to pay interest on that borrowing and eventually repay the principal amount. So, what exactly is government debt, why do governments borrow, who lends them money and how do they repay it? What is government debt? Government debt is the total amount of money a government has borrowed and still owes. A government collects money mainly through taxes and other revenues. It uses this money to pay for public services and programmes, infrastructure, salaries, defence, subsidies and other expenses. But when a government's spending is higher than its income in a particular year, it runs a fiscal deficit. It needs to borrow to make up for the shortfall. That borrowing adds to the government's outstanding debt. For example, suppose a government collects $100 in taxes and other revenue but spends $120. It has a $20 deficit. If it borrows $20 to meet that gap, the borrowing becomes part of its government debt. How does a government incur debt? Governments usually incur debt by issuing securities such as bonds, bills and other debt instruments. Investors buy these securities and, in return, receive interest. When the security matures, the government is expected to return the principal. The US Treasury, for example, borrows by selling Treasury bills, notes and bonds. These securities are bought by investors in the US and abroad. This is different from taking a loan from one particular bank. Government borrowing takes place through large financial markets, where many investors can buy government securities. Who does a government owe this money to? A government can owe money to a wide range of lenders. These can include:• Banks and other financial institutions• Pension and mutual funds• Insurance companies• Businesses• Foreign investors and foreign governments• The country's central bank• Other government institutions or funds The exact mix varies from country to country. In the US, the $40 trillion figure includes debt held by the public as well as intragovernmental debt, which is money owed by one part of the federal government to another. More than $32 trillion of the total is held by the public. Foreign investors are, therefore, only one part of the group that lends money to a government. A large share can also be held domestically. How does a government repay its debt? A government has two main obligations on its debt: interest and principal. It has to make interest payments to investors according to the terms of the securities it has issued. When a bond matures, the government also has to repay the principal. But governments do not necessarily pay off all their debt at once. A government can issue new debt when old debt matures. The money raised from the new borrowing can be used to repay the maturing debt. This is known as refinancing or rolling over debt. This means a government can continue to have a large outstanding debt even when it is regularly paying its obligations. Tax revenues and other government income can also be used to pay interest and repay debt. The key issue, therefore, is not simply whether a government has debt. Governments around the world borrow regularly. The bigger question is whether they can continue to service that debt without creating an unsustainable fiscal burden. What is the difference between a fiscal deficit and government debt? The two terms are related but not the same. A fiscal deficit is the amount by which a government's spending exceeds its revenue during a particular period, usually a financial year. Government debt is the accumulated stock of borrowing over time. Think of it this way: the deficit is the new borrowing requirement for a particular year, while debt is the amount that has built up from borrowing over several years. So, if a government runs a deficit of $10 trillion this year, that does not mean its total debt is $10 trillion. The $10 trillion would be added to the debt it already has, subject to other adjustments. What is a debt ceiling? A debt ceiling is a legal limit on how much a government can borrow. Not every country has such a limit in the same form. The US has a statutory debt ceiling set by the Congress. The important point is that the US debt ceiling is not the same as a limit on government spending. When Congress approves spending and other obligations, the government may need to borrow money to meet them. The debt ceiling determines how much the Treasury can borrow to meet those already-authorised obligations. So, raising the debt ceiling does not itself approve new spending. It allows the government to continue borrowing to pay bills that have already been authorised. What happens when a government reaches its borrowing limit? If a government reaches a legal borrowing limit, it may not be able to raise additional debt unless the limit is increased or the law is changed. In the US, when the debt ceiling is reached, the Treasury can use certain temporary measures to continue meeting the government's obligations. But if those measures run out and the borrowing limit remains unchanged, the government could eventually struggle to make some payments on time. That creates the risk of a default -- a situation in which the government fails to meet an obligation when it is due. A US government default could have consequences well beyond the country because US Treasury securities are widely held by investors around the world. Why is the US debt rising so fast? The US has been running large budget deficits for years, meaning the government has regularly spent more than it has collected in revenue. Wars, economic downturns and the Covid-19 pandemic led to sharp increases in borrowing. More recently, spending on programmes such as Social Security, Medicare and defence, along with rising interest costs, has added to the government's financing needs. Tax cuts can also increase borrowing if they reduce government revenue without corresponding spending cuts, news agency Reuters reported.  On the US national debt crossing $40 trillion, President Donald Trump told LiveNOW from FOX on Friday, “It has been a problem for 35 years.” “The way you handle debt is through growth, and we are having tremendous growth. We have never seen the kind of growth we are having now. This growth will solve it very easily,” he said.

item.title: Video appears to show 600 people abducted in Nigeria mosque attack, residents say
item.description: An armed group posted a video showing what residents said were about 600 women, children and older people abducted in an attack on a mosque in Nigeria’s north-central Niger State.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An armed group posted a video showing what residents said were about 600 women, children and older people abducted in [USN:L6N44J02S TEXT:"an attack"] on a mosque in Nigeria’s north-central Niger State. The video, posted on Sunday on Facebook and WhatsApp, showed large groups of people seated in a forested area surrounded by armed men. Several children could be heard crying in the background. Reuters could not independently verify the authenticity of the video. Police and state authorities did not respond to requests for comment. Mass kidnappings for ransom have become common in parts of northwestern and north-central Nigeria, where heavily armed gangs frequently raid villages, schools and highways. The video surfaced two days after gunmen attacked worshippers at the mosque in Dekara village during Friday prayers, taking people away in what residents said were simultaneous raids on several communities. Police had earlier confirmed an attack on worshippers in the area but said they could not verify the number of people abducted. In the video, a gunman speaking in Hausa addressed families of the captives and urged them to identify relatives among the people in the footage. "These are all your people. We are showing you this video so that you can identify your family members, your fathers, mothers, children and relatives," the gunman said. Resident Jamilu Ibrahim appealed to federal and state authorities to secure the release of the captives, citing the number of mothers with infants and children among those shown in the footage.

item.title: GSK scores regulatory wins for chronic hepatitis B drug, cancer therapy
item.description: GSK said on Monday its experimental chronic hepatitis B drug received its first global approval in Japan, and a key cancer therapy was granted a priority U.S. regulatory review as a possible rectal cancer treatment.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: GSK (GSK.L) said on Monday its experimental chronic hepatitis B drug received its first global approval in Japan, and a key cancer therapy was granted a priority U.S. regulatory review as a possible rectal cancer treatment. Here are some details: The British drugmaker said bepirovirsen, to be branded as Hibsago, has been approved in Japan as the first and only functional cure for chronic hepatitis B in the country. GSK said the approval was based on late-stage studies, which showed that the drug helped nearly [USN:L4N4241LO TEXT:"one-in-five patients"] achieve a functional cure and raised hopes for a finite treatment course as an alternative to lifelong antiviral pills. Bepirovirsen is [USN:L4N4241LO TEXT:"designed"] to tackle hepatitis B in three ways: by blocking viral DNA replication, lowering hepatitis B surface antigen levels in the blood, and boosting immune response for longer-lasting control of the disease. GSK has predicted bepirovirsen could bring in over £2 billion ($2.73 billion) in peak annual sales, taking it closer to its annual revenue target of more than £40 billion by 2031 as its [USN:L6N43U0QG TEXT:"pipeline development comes into focus"]. Separately, GSK said the U.S. FDA will conduct a priority review of dostarlimab, marketed as Jemperli, as a potential treatment for a type of rectal cancer alongside existing approvals of specific endometrial cancer subtypes. The FDA has assigned a February 2027 action date for the rectal cancer review, with the program structure possibly yielding a decision earlier as well. Jemperli, which had also received both Breakthrough Therapy and Fast Track designations by the FDA, is not currently approved anywhere in the world for locally advanced rectal cancer. ($1 = 0.7332 pounds)

item.title: Mercedes no longer have the fastest car in F1, says Antonelli
item.description: McLaren have taken a big step forward and Mercedes no longer have the quickest car in Formula One, championship leader Kimi Antonelli said after Sunday's Dutch Grand Prix.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: McLaren have taken a big step forward and Mercedes no longer have the quickest car in Formula One, championship leader Kimi Antonelli said after Sunday's[USN:L6N44K04A TEXT:" Dutch Grand Prix"]. McLaren's reigning champion Lando Norris celebrated his second win in a row from [USN:L6N44J03J TEXT:"pole position"] at Zandvoort, with Antonelli and Mercedes teammate George Russell second and third ahead of Ferrari pair Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc. "We’re clearly not the fastest car anymore on the grid," said Antonelli, who won five races in a row earlier in the season. "We’re probably second or third, at least in today’s race, and McLaren has taken a huge step, especially since Hungary, since the big upgrade package they brought." Norris, who lost out to Antonelli at the race restart and then had to overtake him on track, questioned that assertion however. "I don’t think it’s true. I think if I didn’t get Kimi when I overtook him, I don’t think I would have won the race," he said. "For once I would give myself a little bit of credit that I feel like I’m doing a better job than everyone, and I think that can also make a difference. "We certainly have a car now capable of beating them ... but I think they have a better all-round performing car than what we do." Zandvoort, and [USN:L6N43S048 TEXT:"Budapest's Hungaroring"] before that, played to McLaren's strengths but some of the tracks coming up may be less favourable. Ferrari can be expected to go well at their home grand prix at Monza early next month, with upgrades in the pipeline, while Antonelli faces [USN:L1N44K03V TEXT:"hefty grid penalties"] for an engine change. A TOUGHER RIDE Mercedes are still way ahead of Ferrari and McLaren in the constructors' championship and scored more points (46 to McLaren's 43 and Ferrari's 31) than anyone else over the weekend. "We have a strong car in certain areas. It’s not like last year where we were pretty good everywhere," said Norris. "We’re very, very strong in high speed, and that’s the place we’ve improved the car the most, is high-speed performance. No one matches us in high speed, and that’s a good thing. "But the advantage that they (Mercedes) have to us in slow speed is also crazy. And therefore, I don’t have the confidence to say 'yeah, I can easily fight for a championship for the rest of the season. "I know I’ve just won two races in a row and had two poles in a row, but at the minute I don’t have the car I need to fight for a championship," added the Briton, who is 83 points behind Antonelli with another 11 rounds remaining unless the situation in the Middle East [USN:L6N43V0R3 TEXT:"forces a calendar change"]. Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said cost-cap restrictions meant Mercedes did not have the money to put developments on the car as fast as they might like to. "We are trying to evenly split that through the season based on our calculations of when we can bring the biggest updates and optimising the championship points," he told reporters. "So the ride has been a bit tougher than at the beginning of the year." McLaren principal Andrea Stella said he expected Mercedes to accelerate their car's development regardless. "I'm sure their car in the wind tunnel is quite a bit faster than the car they have on track," said the Italian. "And they will want to now convert some of this potential into upgrades that make it to the real car. I'm just pretty sure that they will have upgrades."

item.title: ピムコ、タームプレミアム高止まり予想－利回り上昇は債券投資の好機
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 投資家が長期国債を保有する際に求める上乗せ金利は、予想外の景気悪化がない限り、高止まりする可能性が高いと、パシフィック・インベストメント・マネジメント（PIMCO）はみている。利回りの上昇局面は債券を買う好機になるという。

米30年国債の利回りは約20年ぶりの水準まで上昇した。長期債のアンダーパフォームでイールドカーブがスティープ化し、タームプレミアムが上昇した。ピムコによると、欧州や英国、日本でも長期債利回りが上昇している。

ピムコで非伝統的運用戦略の最高投資責任者（CIO）を務めるマーク・サイドナー氏と、新興国市場ポートフォリオ運用責任者のプラモル・ダワン氏はリポートで、「引き続き債券は魅力的だとみており、利回りの上昇が続けば買い増しを検討する。利回り上昇によって、インカムやキャリーに加え、スティープ化したイールドカーブのロールダウン効果による収益機会も得られるためだ」と記した。

米国の公的債務残高が40兆ドル（約6357兆円）を突破し、借り入れコストが急上昇するなか、ベッセント米財務長官は先週、長期債の買い戻し計画を予想外に拡大し、市場の意表を突いた。ただ、市場の安堵は長続きせず、翌日には利回りが再び上昇した。世界的に財政負担や根強いインフレへの懸念がくすぶっている。

JPモルガン・チェースとPGIMは、米財務省の債務管理戦略における予測可能性が低下すれば、最終的に借り入れコストの上昇につながりかねないと警告している。資産家レイ・ダリオ氏は米国の債務危機がわずか3年後に迫っている可能性があると警告し、債券保有を減らすよう投資家に促した。

ピムコは、景気刺激を必要としていない経済への追加的な財政刺激策と、国債供給を巡る見通しの悪化が、利回りを一段と高いレンジに押し上げる主なリスクだと指摘した。

もっとも、米長期国債などの国債利回りは最近の上昇を経ても、過去の長期平均付近にあるにすぎないとピムコは指摘する。サイドナー、ダワン両氏は「現在の利回りが異例に高く見えるのは、世界金融危機後に人為的に抑え込まれていた金利と比べた場合だけだ」と記した。

item.title: Volkswagen-Les salariés inquiets de la communication du directoire
item.description: Les salariés de Volkswagen ont critiqué ce qu’ils ont qualifié de "communication externe désastreuse" de la part du directoire, alors que le plus grand constructeur automobile européen envisage de nouvelles réductions de coûts, selon un article interne du comité d’entreprise consulté lundi par Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Les salariés de Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) ont critiqué ce qu’ils ont qualifié de "communication externe désastreuse" de la part du directoire, alors que le plus grand constructeur automobile européen envisage de nouvelles réductions de coûts, selon un article interne du comité d’entreprise consulté lundi par Reuters. Un sondage en ligne, mené la semaine dernière par le comité d'entreprise du groupe, a révélé que les salariés et leurs familles se sentaient "inquiets et effrayés" par la communication publique de la direction, indique l'article. Les salariés ont également fait part de leurs craintes concernant la sécurité de l’emploi, l’avenir des programmes de préretraite et d’indemnités de départ, ainsi que les perspectives pour les usines de Volkswagen à Emden, Hanovre, Neckarsulm, Osnabrück et Zwickau. Dans une note interne diffusée vendredi, le président du directoire Oliver Blume a déclaré que quatre de ces usines ne devraient pas atteindre un taux d’utilisation des capacités compétitif dans les années 2030, mais a souligné qu’aucune décision n’avait encore été prise concernant la fermeture d’usines spécifiques. Les salariés ont critiqué le manque de précisions fournies vendredi concernant l’avenir de ces usines. Oliver Blume a rejeté les accusations selon lesquelles il dissimulerait des informations. "Nous tenons en permanence nos collègues et les représentants du personnel informés de l’état d’avancement des projets, par le biais de canaux internes, mais avant tout par le biais d’un dialogue personnel direct", avait-il déclaré en juillet dans un entretien publié sur le site web de l’entreprise. Volkswagen traverse actuellement ce qui est considéré comme la plus grande restructuration de son histoire, qui pourrait passer par 50.000 suppressions d'emplois supplémentaires et la scission de certaines divisions. Oliver Blume s’adressera aux salariés lors d’une réunion extraordinaire à Wolfsburg mardi, tandis que Thomas Schmall, directeur de la division Composants et membre du directoire, prendra la parole à Braunschweig. Le comité d'entreprise a convoqué ces réunions en juillet après que les représentants du personnel ont critiqué la communication de la direction concernant les plans visant à améliorer la compétitivité du constructeur automobile.

item.title: El ministro alemán Wadephul instará a Rubio a asumir un papel más activo en relación con Ucrania
item.description: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores alemán, Johann Wadephul, tiene previsto hablar por teléfono este lunes con su homólogo estadounidense, Marco Rubio, para instarle a que se implique más personalmente en los esfuerzos diplomáticos relacionados con la guerra en Ucrania, según ha declarado a la emisora de radio Deutschlandfunk.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El ministro de Asuntos Exteriores alemán, Johann Wadephul, tiene previsto hablar por teléfono este lunes con su homólogo estadounidense, Marco Rubio, para instarle a que se implique más personalmente en los esfuerzos diplomáticos relacionados con la guerra en Ucrania, según ha declarado a la emisora de radio Deutschlandfunk. Wadephul, que ha estado recientemente en Ucrania, dijo a la emisora que, hasta ahora, la diplomacia estadounidense había recaído en gran medida en los enviados presidenciales Jared Kushner y Steve Witkoff. "Quizá yo mismo pueda animarle (a Rubio) a hacer más en ese sentido", dijo el ministro alemán, y añadió que Berlín estaba explorando otras vías para ayudar a reanudar las negociaciones. Alemania está en contacto con varios países, entre ellos Turquía, varios Estados del golfo Pérsico y Egipto, que mantienen vínculos más estrechos con Rusia que la mayoría de los países europeos, señaló Wadephul. Las negociaciones entre Rusia y Estados Unidos para poner fin al conflicto en Ucrania se han estancado en gran medida en medio de la guerra en Irán, y el Kremlin afirmó la semana pasada que aún no disponía de información sobre una posible próxima visita de Kushner y Witkoff. El viceministro de Asuntos Exteriores ruso, Serguéi Riabkov, había declarado el viernes en una entrevista que Rusia estaba dispuesta a escuchar las nuevas ideas de Rubio y a continuar el diálogo con Washington.

item.title: South African rand holds near multi-month high as Iran sanctions loom
item.description: The South African rand opened the week on a firm footing on Monday, hovering near its strongest level since the start of the Iran war, as a subdued dollar, higher gold prices and strength across emerging-market currencies supported the commodity-linked currency.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The South African rand opened the week on a firm footing on Monday, hovering near its strongest level since the start of the Iran war , as a subdued dollar, higher gold prices and strength across emerging-market currencies supported the commodity-linked currency. At 0636 GMT, the rand traded at 15.99 against the dollar , up about 0.2% and not far from its strongest level since the start of the Iran war touched earlier in the session. South Africa's key export, gold, hit its [USN:L1N44L03D TEXT:"highest level in more than three months"] as a subdued dollar lent support, while investors looked ahead to key U.S. inflation data and a speech by Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh later this week. The dollar was [USN:L1N44L061 TEXT:"pinned near multi-month lows"] as traders awaited details of a fresh U.S. sanctions package against Iran. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is due to hold a press conference at 1800 GMT after threatening "[USN:L6N44K07T TEXT:"the toughest sanctions in history"]" on Iran, while Iran's foreign minister [USN:L6N44J01G TEXT:"dismissed"] the threat of new U.S. sanctions as a sign of desperation. Wichard Cilliers, head of market risk at TreasuryONE, said the rand's rally was being driven by broad dollar weakness, strong emerging-market sentiment and higher gold prices. Like other risk-sensitive currencies, the rand has been at the mercy of global market sentiment, particularly since the start of the U.S.-Iran war on February 28. South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond was slightly firmer in early deals, as the yield fell 1.5 basis points to 8.565%.

item.title: Thames Water's creditors line up new board under proposed rescue deal
item.description: A group of senior creditors of struggling British utility Thames Water said on Monday it had picked an initial cohort of directors to lead the debt-laden company if its rescue deal goes through.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A group of senior creditors of struggling British utility Thames Water said on Monday it had picked an initial cohort of directors to lead the debt-laden company if its rescue deal goes through. Mike McTighe, Liz Barber, Clive Selley and Bernadette Kelly are among the proposed non-executive directors for the Thames Water board, the London & Valley Water consortium said. "It is proposed that these individuals will join the Thames Water board to oversee Thames Water's 10-year turnaround and deliver a comprehensive transformation of Thames Water in the interest of customers and the public," the consortium said.

item.title: 米韓、上陸訓練「双竜」を中止 イラン戦争で米軍派遣に制約
item.description: [ソウル ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ソウル ２４日 ロイター] - 韓国海兵隊は２４日、米国が韓国と９月に予定していた師団規模の合同上陸訓練「双竜訓練」を中止したと発表した。米側はイラン戦争の影響で訓練に投入できる部隊が限られることを理由に挙げた。

韓国海兵隊の報道官は記者会見で、米海兵隊から６月に正式に通知があったと明らかにした。報道官によると、両国は訓練再開に向けて緊密な協議を続けている。今後の中止を防ぐ措置や、失われた訓練機会を補う方法については明らかにしなかった。

これに先立ちトランプ米大統領は、２１日に終了した別の合同軍事演習「乙支フリーダムシールド」の規模を縮小するよう命じた。費用に加え、韓国がイラン戦争への参加を拒否したことを理由に挙げた。

item.title: La UE aprueba una nueva ayuda de 6.100 millones de euros para la defensa de Ucrania
item.description: La Comisión Europea aprobó el lunes una nueva ayuda financiera de 6.100 millones de euros (7.120 millones de dólares) para Ucrania, destinada a la adquisición de nuevos sistemas de defensa, como sistemas de defensa aérea, misiles, munición y radares.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Comisión Europea aprobó el lunes una nueva ayuda financiera de 6.100 millones de euros (7.120 millones de dólares) para Ucrania, destinada a la adquisición de nuevos sistemas de defensa, como sistemas de defensa aérea, misiles, munición y radares. La UE señaló que este nuevo paquete de ayuda se suma a los 16.000 millones de euros de planes de adquisición aprobados anteriormente, de los cuales ya se habían desembolsado 8.350 millones de euros. "A medida que Rusia intensifica sus ataques, redoblamos nuestros esfuerzos para ayudar a Ucrania a proteger a su población y defender su espacio aéreo. Europa está del lado de Ucrania y le proporcionaremos lo que necesite, cuando lo necesite", afirmó la presidenta de la Comisión Europea, Ursula von der Leyen, en un comunicado. (1 dólar = 0,8563 euros)

item.title: Report: 49ers trade RB Zamir White to Saints for LB Deion Jones
item.description: The New Orleans Saints are acquiring running back Zamir White from the San Francsico 49ers for linebacker Deion Jones, ESPN reported late Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New Orleans Saints are acquiring running back Zamir White from the San Francsico 49ers for linebacker Deion Jones, ESPN reported late Sunday. Both veteran players were free agents who signed earlier this month with their teams, only to be traded. The Saints could be looking for depth with five-time Pro Bowl running back Alvin Kamara expected to miss 4-6 weeks with a sprained MCL. New Orleans signed free agent Travis Etienne to a four-year contract worth $12 million per season but head coach Kellen Moore said he envisions using a deep committee of running backs. Jones would be reunited with the 49ers' new defensive coordinator Raheem Morris, his coach while both were with the Atlanta Falcons. White is listed on the 49ers "unofficial depth chart" on its website in the fourth running back group, behind starter Christian McCaffrey and four other players. White, who turns 27 on Sept. 18, played in six games last season for the Las Vegas Raiders and had 12 carries for 32 yards along with four receptions on six targets for 24 yards. Las Vegas selected White in the fourth round of the 2022 NFL Draft out of Georgia. For his career, he has 198 rushing attempts for 736 yards and two touchdowns and 25 receptions for 152 yards in 45 games (nine starts) for the Raiders since 2022. He became a free agent in March and signed with the 49ers on Aug. 12. Jones, 31, played in all 17 regular-season games for the Tampa Bay Buccaneers last season as a reserve and totaled 29 tackles. He became a free agent in March and signed with the Saints on Aug. 7. Atlanta picked Jones in the second round of the 2016 draft out of LSU. He was third in the NFL Defensive Rookie of the Year that season when he intercepted three passes, returning two for scores. Jones made the Pro Bowl in his second year, when he made a career-high 138 tackles along with another three picks. For his career, Jones has 761 tackles, 12 sacks, 50 tackles for loss, 24 quarterback hits, 13 interceptions (five returned for TDs), 53 passes defended, five forced fumbles and two fumble recoveries in 128 games (91 starts) for the Falcons (2016-21), Cleveland Browns (2022), Carolina Panthers (2023) and Bucs (2024-25). Morris was a Falcons assistant coach (2015-19), defensive coordinator and interim head coach in 2020 and head coach again in 2024-25. --Field Level Media

item.title: India 419-6 at lunch after fifties by Pant, Jurel
item.description: Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel struck unbeaten fifties to push India to 419-6 at lunch on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka in Colombo on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rishabh Pant and Dhruv Jurel struck unbeaten fifties to push India to 419-6 at lunch on day two of the second and final test against Sri Lanka in Colombo on Monday. Pant, who had retired hurt on Sunday, came out to bat after the fall of debutant Saransh Jain. Pant's 63 not out included six fours and two sixes. Asitha Fernando (4-60) dismissed Jain (six), who was caught at slip. Jurel combined with Pant in a 112-run stand for the unbroken seventh wicket to pad India's score. Jurel hit five fours in his 59 not out. India are 1-0 ahead in the two-test series.

item.title: Equinor, Aker BP make gas find just northwest of Balder field
item.description: Norwegian oil firms Equinor and Aker BP have discovered gas in the so-called Linga prospect 10 miles northwest of the Balder field in the North Sea, the Norwegian offshore directorate said on Monday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Norwegian oil firms Equinor (EQNR.OL) and Aker BP (AKRBP.OL) have discovered gas in the so-called Linga prospect 10 miles northwest of the Balder field in the North Sea, the Norwegian offshore directorate said on Monday. Preliminary estimates put the size of the discovery at between 0.1 and 2.1 million standard cubic metres of recoverable oil equivalent, the offshore directorate said. Equinor operates the prospect and holds a 60% stake, while Aker BP owns the remaining 40%.

item.title: Report: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty believed to have sprained ankle
item.description: Las Vegas running back Ashton Jeanty is believed to have sprained his ankle on Sunday during Raiders practice in Henderson, Nev., according to a co-report from ESPN and NFL Network late Sunday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las Vegas running back Ashton Jeanty is believed to have sprained his ankle on Sunday during Raiders practice in Henderson, Nev., according to a co-report from ESPN and NFL Network late Sunday. Jeanty dove for an attempted reception on a pass route and fell awkwardly on the indoor turf surface, per multiple reports. Jeanty stayed down before being helped from the field by trainers and medical personnel. Jeanty couldn't put weight on his right leg as he left the scene. Raiders players knelt and prayed as Jeanty was assisted. The team declined comment on Jeanty's status, though it's not considered a long-term injury, per the report. Jeanty, 22, is entering his second season after the Raiders made him the No. 6 overall pick in last year's draft. He has been expected to be a major contributor for the Raiders this season. As a rookie, Jeanty ran for 975 yards with five touchdowns. He added 55 receptions for 346 yards and five touchdowns through the air. If Jeanty's injury is serious, it could mean a larger role for rookie Mike Washington Jr., who has been a star of training camp and was a fourth-round choice of the Raiders this spring. --Field Level Media

item.title: VW-Belegschaft kritisiert "desaströse Kommunikation" des Managements
item.description: Im Ringen um ein weiteres Sparpaket bei Europas größtem Autobauer Volkswagen kritisiert die Belegschaft den Kommunikationsstil des Managements. Wegen der "desaströsen Kommunikation nach außen durch den Vorstand" seien die Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien "verunsichert und verängstigt", heißt es in einer Intranet-Meldung des Betriebsrats vom Montag, die der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters vorliegt. Der Betriebsrat habe die Stimmungslage der Belegschaft in der vergangenen Woche online abgefragt. Dabei seien auch Fragen zur Zukunft der Altersteilzeit und der Aufhebungsverträge gestellt worden, zudem sei nach Perspektiven für die Werke in Hannover, Emden, Zwickau und Neckarsulm gefragt worden.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Im Ringen um ein weiteres Sparpaket bei Europas größtem Autobauer Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) kritisiert die Belegschaft den Kommunikationsstil des Managements. Wegen der "desaströsen Kommunikation nach außen durch den Vorstand" seien die Mitarbeiter und ihre Familien "verunsichert und verängstigt", heißt es in einer Intranet-Meldung des Betriebsrats vom Montag, die der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters vorliegt. Der Betriebsrat habe die Stimmungslage der Belegschaft in der vergangenen Woche online abgefragt. Dabei seien auch Fragen zur Zukunft der Altersteilzeit und der Aufhebungsverträge gestellt worden, zudem sei nach Perspektiven für die Werke in Hannover, Emden, Zwickau und Neckarsulm gefragt worden. VW-Chef Oliver Blume stellt sich am Dienstag bei einer außerordentlichen Betriebsversammlung in Wolfsburg den Fragen der Mitarbeiter. Am Mittwoch sind weitere Betriebsversammlungen in Emden und Zwickau geplant. Am Freitag hatte er in einem im Intranet veröffentlichten Interview die Lage als "mehr als kritisch" bezeichnet. "3,8 Prozent operative Rendite sind in dieser anspruchsvollen Situation zwar solide", sagte Blume. "Aber sie reichen bei Weitem nicht aus, um dauerhaft ausreichende Mittel zu erwirtschaften für neue Technologien, neue Produkte und unsere Standorte." Für den Sparkurs appellierte er an die Mitarbeiter. "Auf die nächsten Wochen kommt es an: Alle müssen mitziehen. Wir haben den größten Transformationsplan in der Geschichte des Volkswagen-Konzerns aufgesetzt", sagte Blume der "Bild am Sonntag". Der Betriebsrat kritisierte, dass das interne Interview erst am Freitagnachmittag veröffentlicht worden sei, als zahlreiche Mitarbeiter bereits auf dem Weg ins Wochenende gewesen seien und zu dem Zeitpunkt die entsprechenden Informationen aus den Nachrichten erfahren hätten. Zudem habe Blume weder Details zur Zukunft der Werke in Zwickau, Emden, Hannover und Neckarsulm noch zu einem möglichen Arbeitsplatzabbau genannt. Blume hat angekündigt, die Kapazitäten in den Konzernwerken in Europa um 500.000 Fahrzeuge pro Jahr zu senken. "Für Emden, Hannover, Zwickau und Neckarsulm können wir heute keine wettbewerbsfähige Belegung für die 2030er-Jahre darstellen", sagte er. Zudem sollen die Kosten deutlich reduziert werden. Die Gemeinkosten seien um 30 Prozent höher als bei Wettbewerbern. "Die häufig genannte Zahl von rund 50.000 Stellen weltweit ist dabei keine fixe Zielgröße", sagte der VW-Chef. "Sie errechnet sich aus unserem Kostenziel im Vergleich zum Wettbewerb und gibt eine Orientierung, wie groß unser Handlungsbedarf ist."

item.title: Pro-presidential party in Kazakhstan won 71% of votes in weekend election, electoral commission says
item.description: Adilet, a newly-formed pro-government party in Kazakhstan, has won just over 71% of the vote in a parliamentary election held on Sunday, the electoral commission said on Monday, in a result likely to consolidate President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's power.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Adilet, a newly-formed pro-government party in Kazakhstan, has won just over 71% of the vote in a parliamentary election held on Sunday, the electoral commission said on Monday, in [USN:L1N44K03I TEXT:"a result likely to consolidate"] President [USN:L1N44H092 TEXT:"Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's power"]. Adilet was founded in the Central Asian country earlier this year and is led by top aides to Tokayev. Shortly after its founding, it incorporated the previous ruling party, Amanat. Aside from Adilet, the electoral commission said four other blocs, the pro-business Respublika and Ak Zhol parties, the centre-left Nationwide Social Democratic Party, and the Auyl party, which represents rural voters, had entered parliament. All four opposition parties are seen as broadly supportive of Tokayev's government.

item.title: MLB roundup: Ian Happ, Pedro Ramirez slam Cubs past Mariners
item.description: Ian Happ and Pedro Ramirez hit grand slams as the Chicago Cubs poured it on late in a 19-2 shellacking of the host Seattle Mariners Sunday afternoon.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ian Happ and Pedro Ramirez hit grand slams as the Chicago Cubs poured it on late in a 19-2 shellacking of the host Seattle Mariners Sunday afternoon. Pete Crow-Armstrong and Michael Conforto also homered and right-hander Aaron Civale (6-7) pitched four innings of scoreless relief as the Cubs snapped a three-game losing streak. Chicago brought home nine runs in the eighth inning and tallied 17 hits in the beatdown. Randy Arozarena homered for the Mariners, who had won five of its previous seven games. Arozarena, who hit leadoff and walk-off homers Saturday, went deep again in the first inning Sunday to left field off Cubs starter Shota Imanaga. He became the second player to ever hit consecutive leadoff homers with a walk-off in between, duplicating Crow-Armstrong's feat from earlier in the week. Seattle starter Bryce Miller (4-8) allowed just two hits over 4 1/3 innings but was tagged for six runs due in large part to his seven walks. Imanaga lasted two-plus innings and gave up two runs (one earned) on five hits. It was the Mariners' second lopsided loss of the week, following their 22-0 road loss at Milwaukee on Tuesday. Braves 4, Brewers 2 Tyler Mahle threw five-plus solid innings to continue his impressive run and Michael Harris II homered to help Atlanta post a victory over Milwaukee in the MLB Little League Classic in Williamsport, Pa. Mahle (5-10) allowed one run on six hits. Mahle has a 1.52 ERA in four starts since being traded from the San Francisco Giants. Raisel Iglesias earned a four-out save for Atlanta, which had dropped five of its prior six games. Michael Harris connected on his 21st homer of the season to give Atlanta an insurance run in the top of the ninth. Milwaukee starter Shane Drohan (6-5) threw five innings and allowed two runs and eight hits for the Brewers, who had won six of their last seven. Phillies 6, Cardinals 4 Kyle Schwarber hit a two-run walk-off home run to highlight a six-run, ninth-inning rally as Philadelphia extended its winning streak to nine with a thrilling victory over visiting St. Louis. Philadelphia did not score until Edmundo Sosa's three-run double with two outs in the ninth. Bryan De La Cruz tied it with a single through the left side, and then Schwarber followed by launching a mammoth homer off the batter's eye in center field, delivering the Phillies' first walk-off homer in more than three years. Phillies star left-hander Cristopher Sanchez gave up four runs and nine hits in 6 2/3 innings. Alec Burleson knocked in a pair of runs and Jose Fermin homered for St. Louis, which concluded its season-long road trip with a 5-6 record. Kyle Leahy and four Cardinals relievers combined to blank the Phillies over the first eight innings before things fell apart for Riley O'Brien (3-5). Rays 3, Orioles 1 Tampa Bay's Nick Martinez pitched six one-hit innings and three relievers completed the task in a victory against Baltimore to avoid a series sweep. Chandler Simpson had two hits, including a run-scoring single to cap off the Rays' three-run sixth inning. Martinez (13-4) struck out four batters without issuing a walk. The only hit he allowed was Colton Cowser's one-out double in the third inning. American League-best Tampa Bay won for only the third time in their last 10 games. Cowser had both of the Orioles' hits, including a ninth-inning home run off Bryan Baker, who recorded his 37th save of the season. Shane Baz (4-14), who's winless in his last 12 starts, was charged with three runs on five hits in 5 2/3 innings against his former team. Yankees 8, Blue Jays 3 Trent Grisham worked out a two-out, bases-loaded walk to break a tie in the sixth inning, Ben Rice followed with a two-run single and New York earned a victory over visiting Toronto to claim the series. The Yankees won for the sixth time in seven games and 10th time in 15 games thanks to getting four hits in the sixth off Toronto starter Jose Soriano (10-7) and reliever Mason Fluharty. Jazz Chisholm Jr. and Grisham each added their 18th homer of the season for New York. Yankees starter Carlos Rodon allowed two runs (one earned) on two hits in four innings in his second start since returning from left elbow inflammation. The Blue Jays, who finished a 13-game stretch against AL East opponents with an 8-5 record, scored their runs on sacrifice flies by Brett Bateman and Daz Cameron and an Alejandro Kirk RBI single. Athletics 7, Astros 6 Max Muncy slugged a tiebreaking home run with two outs in the top of the seventh inning and the visiting Athletics rallied from a six-run deficit to claim the rubber match of a three-game series in Houston. Muncy crushed a 1-2 fastball from Astros reliever Steven Okert (6-2) 409 feet to center field, snapping a 6-6 deadlock. That was the deciding blow against the Astros, who dropped into a tie atop the American League West with the Texas Rangers. The Athletics trailed 6-0 entering the top of the fifth before fashioning the comeback with a six-run inning, first against Astros starter Cristian Javier before continuing it against reliever Enyel De Los Santos. The big blow was a three-run homer by No. 9 hitter Brian Serven. Marlins 6, Nationals 2 Xavier Edwards stroked a go-ahead, two-run single in the fifth inning as host Miami completed a three-game sweep with a victory over Washington. Miami improved to 8-1 against Washington this season. Marlins reliever Michael Petersen (3-3) got one out to earn the win. While the Marlins are National League wild-card contenders, the Nationals have lost 10 of their past 12 games. Nationals rookie starter Jackson Kent (0-2) took the loss, allowing three runs and four hits in 4 2/3 innings. Dodgers 4, Pirates 0 Blake Snell delivered his third consecutive strong outing in his return from an elbow procedure and Los Angeles finished off a three-game sweep over visiting Pittsburgh. Alek Thomas had an RBI single in his second game with the Dodgers and Hunter Feduccia added his own RBI single as the Dodgers extended their winning streak to six games while improving to 10-3 since Aug. 10. Snell (2-1) gave up just two hits over six scoreless innings. Brandon Lowe and Spencer Horwitz had singles for the Pirates on an otherwise ineffective day on offense. Pittsburgh right-hander Carmen Mlodzinski followed opener Lake Bachar -- who went two innings -- and gave up most of the damage: three runs allowed on five hits over three innings. Rangers 5, Angels 3 Cal Quantrill tossed six scoreless innings and Ezequiel Duran and Elias Diaz each belted a solo homer, lifting Texas to a victory over Los Angeles in the rubber match at Arlington, Texas. Quantrill (6-4) allowed six hits. He posted his second straight scoreless outing and has yielded just one run on 14 hits over his last four appearances (19 innings). Corey Seager had a pair of singles to record his sixth multi-hit performance in seven games. Yusei Kikuchi (0-4) permitted five runs on seven hits in five innings in his return from the 60-day injured list for the Angels. He had been sidelined since April with left shoulder inflammation. Los Angeles' Zach Neto went deep to lead off the eighth inning for his team-leading 22nd homer of the season. White Sox 2, Mets 1 Tristan Peters hit a walk-off homer in the ninth inning for Chicago, which edged visiting New York in the rubber game of a three-game series. Peters' one-out blast to center off Kodai Senga (0-9) glanced off the glove of a leaping A.J. Ewing for his second quirky homer in as many days. Andrew Benintendi snapped a scoreless tie with an eighth-inning RBI double for the American League Central-leading White Sox. Carson Benge and Francisco Lindor had two hits apiece for the last-place Mets, who fell to 12-6 since the trade deadline. New York starter Nolan McLean recorded another solid start by allowing one hit over six innings. Red Sox 5, Giants 4 Boston flipped a one-run deficit with three runs off three straight two-out hits in the fourth inning en route to a win over visiting San Francisco. Mickey Gasper's pinch-hit double knocked in the go-ahead run. Ceddanne Rafaela went 3-for-4 with two RBIs, and Nick Sogard doubled and homered to lead four Red Sox with multi-hit games. Jake Bennett (8-6) bounced back from a 23-pitch first inning to complete seven frames for the third time. He allowed four runs (three earned). Jonah Cox homered and both he and Bryce Eldridge went 2-for-4 for the Giants. Royals 11, Tigers 7 Nick Loftin and John Rave hit home runs as Kansas City outlasted visiting Detroit to finish off a 7-0 homestand, part of an eight-game winning streak. Loftin was 3-for-4 with four RBIs out of the leadoff spot for the Royals. The long ball by Loftin was the highlight of a five-run second for Kansas City. Rave had the big hit in the fifth, a 407-foot two-run homer, after RBI doubles by Vinnie Pasquantino and Salvador Perez. All four runs were charged to left-hander Andrew Sears, who was making his MLB debut. John Schreiber (1-3) got the Royals' last two outs of the sixth to earn the win. Sears (0-1) was the bulk pitcher on a bullpen day for Detroit, allowing five runs in four-plus innings. Guardians 7, Rockies 2 Chase DeLauter tripled twice, singled, walked and drove in two runs, helping Cleveland beat Colorado in Denver to complete a three-game sweep. Jo Adell, Steven Kwan, Austin Hedges and Angel Martinez finished with two hits apiece for the Guardians. Foster Griffin (15-4) allowed two runs on five hits in five innings to improve to 3-1 since being acquired from the Washington Nationals at the Aug. 3 trade deadline. Brett Sullivan had an RBI double for Colorado, which went 0-6 on its homestand and has been swept in three consecutive home series. Rockies starter Tomoyuki Sugano (12-7) lasted just three innings, surrendering five runs on nine hits. Padres 8, Twins 1 Fernando Tatis Jr. homered twice and knocked in four runs, while Jackson Merrill added a homer as host San Diego completed a three-game sweep of Minnesota for its 21st win in 28 games. Walker Buehler (8-6) allowed only four hits and a run in six innings. The Twins' Brooks Lee homered off Buehler in the fifth. The game was tied 1-1 in the bottom of the sixth when the Padres pounced on the Minnesota bullpen. With one out, Kody Funderburk (3-2) walked Luis Campusano and pinch hitter Austin Hays. Jeff Hoffman relieved and walked Xander Bogaerts to load the bases. Luis Rengifo grounded a two-run double, followed by Tatis' two-run single for a 5-1 lead. Diamondbacks 5, Reds 3 Ildemaro Vargas hit a go-ahead two-run triple in a four-run seventh inning, Corbin Carroll had two extra-base hits and an RBI, and Arizona overcame a three-run deficit to beat Cincinnati in Phoenix. Vargas and Tim Tawa had two hits apiece, and six relievers combined to throw six scoreless innings. Jonathan Loiaisiga (5-3), the third Diamondbacks reliever, pitched a scoreless seventh for the win. Reds starter Andrew Abbott (6-9) gave up seven hits and four runs in six-plus innings. Sal Stewart and Dane Myers had two hits each for Cincinnati, which has lost four of its last six. --Field Level Media

item.title: Wadephul nach Ukraine-Reise: Will Rubio zu neuer Initiative bringen
item.description: Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul will nach eigenen Angaben am heutigen Montag mit seinem US-Kollegen Marco Rubio telefonieren und ihm Eindrücke seiner jüngsten Reise in die Ukraine schildern. Er wolle Rubio bitten, im Sinne der Ukraine persönlich aktiv zu werden, sagte der CDU-Politiker im Deutschlandfunk. Die US-Diplomatie sei in dieser Hinsicht bisher im Wesentlichen in den Händen der Gesandten Jared Kushner und Steve Witkoff gewesen. "Möglicherweise kann ich ihn (Rubio) selber auch veranlassen, dort noch mehr zu machen, aber wir werden auch auf anderen Wegen versuchen, jetzt Gespräche anzustoßen."
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bundesaußenminister Johann Wadephul will nach eigenen Angaben am heutigen Montag mit seinem US-Kollegen Marco Rubio telefonieren und ihm Eindrücke seiner jüngsten Reise in die Ukraine schildern. Er wolle Rubio bitten, im Sinne der Ukraine persönlich aktiv zu werden, sagte der CDU-Politiker im Deutschlandfunk. Die US-Diplomatie sei in dieser Hinsicht bisher im Wesentlichen in den Händen der Gesandten Jared Kushner und Steve Witkoff gewesen. "Möglicherweise kann ich ihn (Rubio) selber auch veranlassen, dort noch mehr zu machen, aber wir werden auch auf anderen Wegen versuchen, jetzt Gespräche anzustoßen." Es gebe eine Reihe weiterer Länder, die "einen engeren Gesprächskontakt als praktisch alle Europäer zu Russland haben", sagte Wadephul in dem Telefoninterview während seiner Rückreise. Konkret nannte er die Türkei, viele Golfstaaten und Ägypten. Mit diesen Ländern spreche die Bundesregierung. Es sei an der Zeit, parallel zur anhaltenden Unterstützung der Ukraine auch diplomatisch einen neuen Anlauf zur Beendigung des Krieges zu nehmen. "Russland wird sich militärisch nicht in der Art und Weise durchsetzen können, wie Putin das mal geplant hat. Das ist gescheitert", so Wadephul. Er wolle diesen Herbst nutzen, um "alles zu versuchen, dass wir eine diplomatische Lösung finden können - mindestens erstmal einen Waffenstillstand." Auf den Tag genau seit viereinhalb Jahren wehrt sich die Ukraine mit westlicher Unterstützung gegen den groß angelegten russischen Angriff. Zuletzt hat die Ukraine verstärkt mit einem Mangel an Munition für Raketenabwehrsysteme zu kämpfen. Wadephul erklärte, er setze sich bei anderen Ländern für die Lieferung von Patriot-Munition ein. "Was die Bundeswehr zur Verfügung gestellt hat, das ging wirklich an die Grenze des Verantwortbaren", so Wadephul. Er habe von Ländern wie Südkorea und Griechenland in dieser Hinsicht weder Zusagen noch Absagen erhalten. Am Montag begeht die Ukraine ihren 35. Unabhängigkeitstag. Zu diesem Anlass reisen einige westliche Spitzenpolitiker nach Kiew, so der neue britische Premierminister Andy Burnham. Eine Konferenz der sogenannten Koalition der Willigen zur Unterstützung der Ukraine ist parallel teils mit Teilnahme in Präsenz und teils virtuell geplant.

item.title: Volkswagen workers criticise board's communication
item.description: Volkswagen employees have criticised what they called the management board's "disastrous external communication" as Europe's largest automaker considers further cost cuts.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Volkswagen (VOWG.DE) employees have criticised what they called the management board's "disastrous external communication" as Europe's largest automaker considers [USN:L8N44I0TG TEXT:"further cost cuts"], according to an internal works council article seen by Reuters on Monday. An online survey, conducted last week by Volkswagen's Group works council, found that employees and their families were "unsettled and frightened" by the board's public communication, the article said. Employees also raised concerns about job security, the future of early-retirement and severance programmes, and prospects for Volkswagen's plants in Emden, Hanover, Neckarsulm, Osnabrueck and Zwickau. In [USN:L8N44I0TG TEXT:"an internal company memo on Friday"], CEO Oliver Blume said four of those plants were not expected to reach competitive capacity utilisation in the 2030s, but stressed that there was no decision yet on specific plant closures. The workers criticised the lack of details on the future of these plants provided on Friday. Blume has rejected accusations of withholding information. "We continuously keep our colleagues and employee representatives informed about the status of the plans—through internal channels, but above all through direct personal dialogue," he said in July in an interview published on the company's website. Volkswagen is undergoing what is considered to be its largest-ever restructuring, possibly ranging from a further [USN:L8N42Y0CC TEXT:"50,000 job cuts"] to the [USN:L8N42Y1AR TEXT:"carve-out of some divisions"]. Blume will address employees at an extraordinary meeting in Wolfsburg on Tuesday and Thomas Schmall, head of components and a member of the management board, will speak in Braunschweig. The works council called the meetings in July after employee representatives criticised the management's communication over plans to improve the automaker's competitiveness.

item.title: 中国南西部で台風19号による洪水、5万人以上が避難 台湾も豪雨
item.description: 中国南西部の広西チワン族自治区で先週末、台風19号に伴う豪雨で洪水が発生し、数万人が避難を余儀なくされた。気象当局は今後数日もさらなる大雨に警戒するよう呼びかけている。 中国国営中央テレビ（CCTV）によると、洪水の影響で約5万4000人が避難した。 台風19号は南シナ海北西部のトンキン湾付近に数日間停滞し、広西チワン族自治区のほか近隣の海南省や広東省に大雨をもたらしている。 CCTVによると、中国南部の一部地域では26日にかけて大雨が続く見通しで、広西チワン族自治区と広東、海南、福建の各省では豪雨が予想されている。 一方、台湾南部の広い地域で24日、豪雨のため地方政府が官公庁や学校を休業・休校とした。今週末には台風が台湾北部に影響を及ぼす見通しとなっている。 台湾南部ではここ数日、低気圧が停滞し、豪雨が発生し、洪水を引き起こしている。

item.title: Germany's Wadephul to urge Rubio to take more active role on Ukraine
item.description: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul plans to speak to his U.S. counterpart, Marco Rubio, by phone on Monday to urge him to become more personally involved in diplomatic efforts related to the war in Ukraine, he told radio broadcaster Deutschlandfunk.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul plans to speak to his U.S. counterpart, Marco Rubio, by phone on Monday to urge him to become more personally involved in diplomatic efforts related to the war in Ukraine, he told radio broadcaster Deutschlandfunk. Wadephul, who was recently in Ukraine, told the broadcaster that U.S. diplomacy had so far been handled largely by presidential envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff. "I may be able to encourage him (Rubio) myself to do more there," the German minister said, adding that Berlin was pursuing other channels to help restart negotiations. Germany is in contact with a number of countries, including Turkey, several Gulf states and Egypt, which maintain closer ties with Russia than most European countries, Wadephul said. Negotiations between Russia and the U.S. to bring about an end to the conflict in Ukraine have largely stalled amid the war in Iran, and the Kremlin said last week that it had no information yet on a possible next visit by Kushner and Witkoff. Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov [USN:L8N44I03X TEXT:"had said"] in an interview on Friday that Russia was ready to listen to [USN:L6N43P0OE TEXT:"Rubio's new ideas"] and continue dialogue with Washington.

item.title: 独極右ＡｆＤ党首、州選挙で単独政権に自信 国政勝利の足がかりに
item.description:
Maria Martinez
[ベルリン ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２３日 ロイター] - 独極右政党「ドイツのための選択肢（ＡｆＤ）」のワイデル共同党首は２３日、９月６日に行われるザクセン・アンハルト州議会選で躍進し、将来の国政選挙で勝利する足がかりにすると意気込みを示した。

公共放送ＺＤＦとのインタビューで「われわれはザクセン・アンハルト州で政権を樹立する」と主張。単独の州政権を目指すとしている同州のＡｆＤ筆頭候補の発言からさらに踏み込み、単独政権樹立に必要な過半数を確保できるとの自信を示した。

インフラテスト・ディマップの世論調査によると、ＡｆＤの支持率は４１％で、メルツ首相率いる保守政党キリスト教民主同盟（ＣＤＵ）の２４％を大きく引き離している。

ＡｆＤは過去に一部地方選挙で高い支持を得たものの、他の主要政党が全て協力を拒否しているため、州政権にも連邦政権にも参画したことがない。

ワイデル氏は、ＡｆＤとの協力を拒むＣＤＵの姿勢は保守勢力を弱体化させており、いずれ自党を国政を運営する立場に押し上げると主張。「ＣＤＵは二度と連邦議会選で勝てないだろう」と述べた。

item.title: Uniper und Equinor unterzeichnen langfristigen Gasliefervertrag
item.description: Der Energiekonzern Uniper baut seinen Gasbezug mit einem langfristigen Liefervertrag in Norwegen aus. Uniper habe einen Vertrag mit dem norwegischen Energieriesen Equinor unterzeichnet, teilten die Unternehmen am Montag mit. Uniper beziehe von 2027 bis 2041 jährlich mehr als 30 Terawattstunden (TWh) Erdgas. Dies entspreche grob dem Gasverbrauch von mehr als zwei Millionen Haushalten in Deutschland pro Jahr. Die Vereinbarung stärke die Versorgungssicherheit des deutschen Marktes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Der Energiekonzern Uniper (UN0k.DE) baut seinen Gasbezug mit einem langfristigen Liefervertrag in Norwegen aus. Uniper habe einen Vertrag mit dem norwegischen Energieriesen Equinor (EQNR.OL) unterzeichnet, teilten die Unternehmen am Montag mit. Uniper beziehe von 2027 bis 2041 jährlich mehr als 30 Terawattstunden (TWh) Erdgas. Dies entspreche grob dem Gasverbrauch von mehr als zwei Millionen Haushalten in Deutschland pro Jahr. Die Vereinbarung stärke die Versorgungssicherheit des deutschen Marktes. Equinor gehört bereits jetzt zu den wichtigsten Gaslieferanten Deutschlands. Der mehrheitlich staatlich kontrollierte Konzern hatte im Zuge der Energiekrise 2022 frühere Gasmengen Russlands teilweise ersetzt. "Mit dieser Vereinbarung stärken wir die langfristige Gasversorgung Deutschlands und vertiefen zugleich unsere Zusammenarbeit mit Equinor", sagte Uniper-Chef Michael Lewis. Gemeinsam wollten die Unternehmungen Lösungen für Erdgas mit geringeren Emissionen in Deutschland weiterentwickeln. Norwegen sei ein wichtiger Partner für die Energieversorgung Europas. Diese Vereinbarung unterstreiche die starke Nachfrage nach zuverlässigen, langfristigen Gaslieferungen aus Norwegen, erklärte Equinor-Chef Anders Opedal. Sie stärke zudem die Rolle von Equinor als verlässlicher langfristiger Energiepartner für Europa.

item.title: Taiwan indicts nine over alleged illegal export of AI servers to China
item.description: Taiwan prosecutors said on Monday they indicted nine people, including employees of Nvidia and Super Micro , accused of illegal export of artificial intelligence servers to China.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Taiwan prosecutors said on Monday they indicted nine people, including employees of Nvidia (NVDA.O) and Super Micro (SMCI.O) , accused of illegal export of artificial intelligence servers to China. Semiconductor powerhouse Taiwan is the world's largest producer of advanced chips used in AI applications. Prosecutors this year investigated the suspected illegal export of servers equipped with Nvidia chips subject to U.S. export controls. Washington has imposed curbs since 2022 making it illegal for such semiconductors to be exported or sold in China. In a statement, the prosecutors in the northern port city of Keelung said the defendants, whose full names they did not state, were "fully aware" that both Nvidia and Super Micro have "rigorous internal control procedures" regarding exports. However, the defendants "colluded with one another at various levels for enormous profit, illegally exporting high-end servers, increasing corporate compliance costs, and severely damaging our nation's international image", they added. Neither Nvidia nor Super Micro immediately responded to requests for comment. Taiwan has tightened export controls in recent years to keep advanced technology and know-how from reaching China, which claims the democratically governed island as its own territory despite the strong objections of the island's government.

item.title: Las ventas de autos eléctricos en Europa crecen por altos precios del petróleo y subsidios
item.description: Las ventas de vehículos eléctricos se aceleraron en gran parte de Europa en julio, debido a que los elevados precios del petróleo, las ayudas y la disponibilidad de modelos más asequibles animaron a los consumidores a deshacerse de sus coches con motor de combustión, según datos facilitados a Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Nick Carey
item.content:encoded: Las ventas de vehículos eléctricos se aceleraron en gran parte de Europa en julio, debido a que los elevados precios del petróleo, las ayudas y la disponibilidad de modelos más asequibles animaron a los consumidores a deshacerse de sus coches con motor de combustión, según datos facilitados a Reuters. Las ventas de vehículos eléctricos se han disparado en toda Europa desde que comenzó la guerra en Irán en febrero y provocó un encarecimiento del precio de la gasolina. La gran pregunta para muchos en el sector del automóvil es si el interés de los consumidores se desvanecerá cuando bajen los precios del petróleo, mientras que la falta de puntos de recarga públicos sigue siendo una de las principales preocupaciones. "La gente busca formas de protegerse de la volatilidad de los precios del combustible y los vehículos eléctricos son una forma estupenda de hacerlo", dijo a Reuters Adam Wood, director general de Renault (RENA.PA) UK, en el concesionario del fabricante francés en Letchworth, a 64 kilómetros al norte de Londres. "Nos encontramos en un punto de inflexión en el que los vehículos eléctricos (…) forman parte de la corriente dominante". Hace dos años, solo el 10% de las ventas de Renault en Reino Unido correspondían a vehículos eléctricos. Por el contrario, en julio de este año los vehículos eléctricos representaron más del 50% de los pedidos de la empresa y el Renault 5 —una versión renovada del modelo más vendido de Renault, lanzado originalmente en 1972— fue el mes pasado el coche eléctrico más vendido en Reino Unido, habiendo evolucionado su forma cuadrada original hacia un diseño más curvilíneo que, según la página web de Renault, ofrece una autonomía de hasta 400 kilómetros. A finales de este año, Renault también comenzará a comercializar el Twingo eléctrico, cuyo precio de salida será inferior a 20.000 libras (26.984 dólares), sin contar una posible subvención del Gobierno británico a la que Renault espera poder optar. "NO HAY NINGUNA POSIBILIDAD DE QUE VUELVA ATRÁS" Charlotte Merrell, de 32 años, acaba de comprarse un Renault Mégane eléctrico, su primer vehículo eléctrico. Según ella, recargar en casa cuesta poco más de 1 libra, frente a las 60 libras que le costaba su anterior modelo con motor de combustión. Comprar un vehículo eléctrico fue "la mejor decisión que he tomado nunca", dijo Merrell. "No hay posibilidad de que vuelva atrás". Según datos del sector, las ventas de vehículos eléctricos en la Unión Europea aumentaron un 40,5% en el primer semestre del año, en comparación con el mismo periodo de 2025, hasta superar los 1,2 millones de coches, lo que representa el 20,7% del total de ventas. Los datos facilitados a Reuters por el grupo de investigación New Automotive y la asociación sectorial E-Mobility Europe muestran que las matriculaciones de vehículos eléctricos aumentaron un 13% interanual en julio en 16 mercados que abarcan más del 90% de las ventas de automóviles en la UE y la Asociación Europea de Libre Comercio. Esto significa que los vehículos eléctricos representaron el 25,7% de todas las ventas de turismos nuevos en esos mercados. (1 dólar = 0,7412 libras)

item.title: Xiaomi launches new Xring chip, partners with TSMC for production, sources say
item.description: Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi on Monday unveiled a new version of its in-house Xring handset processor, betting that deeper control over key components will help strengthen its supply chain and reduce reliance on external chip suppliers.
item.dc:creator: Che Pan, Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: Chinese smartphone maker Xiaomi (1810.HK) on Monday unveiled a new version of its in-house Xring handset processor, betting that deeper control over key components will help strengthen its supply chain and reduce reliance on external chip suppliers. The introduction of Xring O3 comes a year after Xiaomi launched its first proprietary smartphone processor, the Xring O1, marking the latest step in the world's third-largest smartphone vendor's push to join rivals such as Apple (AAPL.O) , Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and Huawei in developing its own chips. TSMC (2330.TW) will manufacture the new chip using its 3-nanometre production technology, two people familiar with the matter said. One of the sources said the chip is expected to power Xiaomi's upcoming flagship folding phone, with a shipment target of 200,000 to 300,000 units. Xiaomi's expansion into foldable phones, a more expensive segment of the market, could challenge leading domestic player Huawei. Huawei shipped 1.6 million foldable phones in China in the second quarter, giving it a 68% market share, followed by Honor with 13.7% and Oppo with 8.5%, according to research firm Smart Analytics Global. The people declined to be identified because the plans are not public. Xiaomi and TSMC did not immediately respond to requests for comment on the chip's manufacturer, production technology or shipment targets. Smartphone processors, or system-on-chips (SoC), integrate computing, graphics, AI processing and imaging functions into a single component. DEVICE MAKERS PUSH FOR IN-HOUSE CHIPS Xiaomi's chip push reflects a broader industry trend as device makers seek to differentiate products and lessen dependence on suppliers such as Qualcomm (QCOM.O) and MediaTek (2454.TW) amid intensifying competition in premium smartphones. Xiaomi said during an earnings call last week that cumulative shipments of devices powered by the Xring O1, including smartphones, tablets and watches, had surpassed 1 million units since its launch. Xiaomi has sold about 150,000 smartphones based on the Xring O1 chip since its May 2025 launch, according to the sources. MEMORY COSTS PUSHING UP PRICES Smartphone makers are contending with a global downturn in device sales, as memory and component costs push up prices and squeeze demand. Xiaomi sold 65 million handsets in the first half of 2026 at an average price of 1,329 yuan ($197.74), compared with 84 million units sold at an average price of 1,141 yuan in the same period of 2025 and 83 million units at 1,123 yuan in 2024, according to data from Visible Alpha by S&P Global. Global smartphone shipments are expected to decline 14% in 2026, according to research firm International Data Corporation. Xiaomi said on Monday it had also contracted TSMC to manufacture two other Xring chips: the Xring O100, a 6-nm neural processing unit that will support Xiaomi's large language model, MiMo, on consumer electronic devices, and the Xring D100, a 3-nm chip for autonomous driving. According to Xiaomi, the O3 has already entered mass production, while the O100 and D100 have completed development and are slated for deployment next year.
